## Focus

My doctoral work in Biostatistics at the University of Nebraska Medical Center focuses on clinical trial methodology, Bayesian statistics, causal inference, and the integration of machine learning into biostatistical practice. My applied work spans cardiometabolic disease, inflammatory aging, cancer, and health disparities.
